description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Multi-criteria screener across tracked space companies: filter by sector, country, tag, public/private status, disclosed private funding, obligated federal awards, Space Score, active ATS open roles and raising-now status. Deterministic database results.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "United States", "US", "GB".

is_public.description: true for listed companies only, false for private only.

limit.description: How many matching companies to return (1 to 25).

min_federal_obligated_usd.description: Minimum federal prime awards obligated in US dollars.

min_total_raised_usd.description: Minimum disclosed private funding in US dollars.

only_raising_now.description: Only companies with an open raise in progress.

name: company_screener
title: Company screener
